title: Premium excessive
body: App is nice, but the price is high at 10€ monthly (more than a Netflix subscription).
author: Ufon Vojta

title: Excited but disappointed
body: Overall I was very pleased at the beginning. Great user interface and graphics. I was able to have five habits to track for free which was  welcomed change compared to other free habit trackers. All of sudden after a month of using I wasn’t able to log another finished activity unless paying 10$ a month premium subscription. Idk the price seems excessive even though I enjoyed the app.
author: majousek
